Thanks Sofia — quick readout from CS below. I also uploaded a short playbook for the expansion (CS_Playbook_QuarterBridge.pdf).

Customer health snapshot (today):
- Product usage: 47% of target DAU for license tier in pilot features (up 8% month-over-month).
- NPS from QBR: 7.8 (concerns on onboarding speed for two integrations).
- Open high-severity tickets: 1 (integration with internal SSO); estimated resolution 12/15 if customer provides logs by 12/09).
- Exec sponsor: remains Emily Park (VP Product) — she committed to internal advocacy but needs procurement timeline to be tight to prioritize budget.

Risk assessment: Medium. The integration blocker is the primary gating item. If integration logs arrive by 12/09 we can target a go-live on 2027-01-10. If not, push to 2027-01-24.

Recommendation for Finance: mark as contingent commit for Q1 with a 70% likelihood. If procurement sends a PO by 12/17, treat as firm.

Action items: 
- Alex/Nila: share PO approver + procurement cadence.
- Sofia/Karthik: confirm whether contingent commits are acceptable in your Q1 model (we can provide a 70% likelihood note).
